title: Tomorrow Starts Here
creativeBrief: Evening anxiety → quiet connection → confident morning. The app appears once, blurred, as a helper. Child protagonist throughout. Bridge the gap between tonight's setup and tomorrow's first step.

scenes.pikaPrompt: Documentary evening in a Swedish home, tired parent at kitchen table rubbing temples, tomorrow's stress visible in body language, child restless on stair in background, lunch boxes half-packed, blue-hour light through windows, handheld authenticity, no phones, no readable text, emotional not melodramatic
